premise: In hide-and-seek Ankylosaurus is too round to hide behind anything, so he tucks in under his armour on the big flat rock; Pteranodon lands on him to look around, and Pachycephalosaurus knocks on him — knock, knock — and the rock giggles.
inspiration: The trickster who hides in plain sight (folk tale), turned gentle: being just himself is the perfect hiding place.
lesson: What makes you different can be just what you need.
learning: Ankylosaurus was covered in armour of hard, bony plates.

en-US.title: The Rock That Giggled
en-US.text: [playfully] {pachycephalosaurus:enter} Pachycephalosaurus closed his eyes. "One… two… three… I'm counting to ten!" {ankylosaurus:enter} {ankylosaurus:live look-around} Ankylosaurus looked for somewhere to hide. Behind the tree fern? His bumpy back stuck out. Behind a boulder? His club tail stuck out. [nervously] Oh dear. So he {ankylosaurus:go to rockside} trundled over to the foot of the big flat rock and {ankylosaurus:live hide hold} tucked in his head and his legs. His back was covered in armour, hard bony plates and bumps, so now… he looked just like a rock. [whispers] Shhh. "Ten! Coming!" {pteranodon:enter} {pteranodon:go to rocks} Pteranodon swooped over to help look. {pteranodon:go on ankylosaurus} She landed on the round rock for a better view, {pteranodon:live look-around} and looked all around. [curious] "Nobody up here," she said. {pachycephalosaurus:go to ankylosaurus} Pachycephalosaurus came up and gave the rock a {pachycephalosaurus:live bonk} gentle knock with his round head. {sfx:knock} Knock, knock! {ankylosaurus:shake} The rock… giggled. {pteranodon:face surprised} {pteranodon:hop} "Rocks don't giggle!" {ankylosaurus:live hide resume} Out popped a little head, and four short legs. {ankylosaurus:face happy} [laughs] "Found you!" laughed Pachycephalosaurus. {all:face happy} {pteranodon:wobble} And Pteranodon laughed hardest of all. She had been sitting on him the whole time!

es-ES.title: La roca que se reía
es-ES.text: [playfully] {pachycephalosaurus:enter} Paquicefalosaurio se tapó los ojos. —Uno… dos… tres… ¡cuento hasta diez! {ankylosaurus:enter} {ankylosaurus:live look-around} Anquilosaurio buscó dónde esconderse. ¿Detrás del helecho gigante? Asomaba su espalda de bultos. ¿Detrás de una piedra? Asomaba su cola de maza. [nervously] Ay, ay. Así que {ankylosaurus:go to rockside} se fue al pie de la gran roca plana y {ankylosaurus:live hide hold} escondió la cabeza y las patas. Su espalda era una armadura de placas de hueso, duras y llenas de bultos: ahora… parecía una roca más. [whispers] Chist. —¡Diez! ¡Voy! {pteranodon:enter} {pteranodon:go to rocks} Pteranodon llegó volando a ayudar. {pteranodon:go on ankylosaurus} Se posó en la roca redonda {pteranodon:live look-around} y miró a todas partes. [curious] —Aquí arriba no hay nadie —dijo. {pachycephalosaurus:go to ankylosaurus} Paquicefalosaurio se acercó y dio a la roca un {pachycephalosaurus:live bonk} toquecito con la cabeza. {sfx:knock} ¡Toc, toc! {ankylosaurus:shake} Y la roca… se rio bajito. {pteranodon:face surprised} {pteranodon:hop} —¡Las rocas no se ríen! {ankylosaurus:live hide resume} Asomó una cabecita, y luego cuatro patas cortas. {ankylosaurus:face happy} [laughs] —¡Te encontré! —se rio Paquicefalosaurio. {all:face happy} {pteranodon:wobble} Y Pteranodon se rio más que nadie. ¡Había estado sentada encima de él todo el rato!
